documents.title: SI (Civil et al) 2026 Notification dated 29-07-2026
documents.url_basis: Held deliberately conservative. The URL string above was CONSTRUCTED by analogy with a sibling file observed on the official domain (PC (Civil et al) 2026 Notification dated 29-07-2026.pdf, same /SI_PC_2026/ directory); it was never returned by the board's own domain, and it is NOT the route by which the stored bytes arrived — the user downloaded the file in a browser (see acquisition). It was INFERRED_UNVERIFIED before acquisition and is downgraded to UNKNOWN rather than upgraded, because acquiring the document out of band confirms the document, not the URL. url_corroboration records the one piece of real evidence that the path is probably right.

url_corroboration.observation: The stored file's name is 'SI+(Civil+et+al)+2026+Notification+dated+29-07-2026.pdf'. That is exactly the basename of the inferred URL with every %20 rendered as +, including the parentheses.
url_corroboration.control: The same transform holds exactly for DOC-OFF-003, whose full URL WAS observed on the official domain — its observed basename contains a double %20 before 'dated', and the stored file name contains a matching double +. A coincidence would not reproduce that quirk.
url_corroboration.strength: Corroborating, not conclusive. It supports the file name, not the /SI_PC_2026/ directory, and a browser could in principle have rewritten the name. Recorded as evidence; url_status stays UNKNOWN.
url_corroboration.how_to_settle: One successful DIRECT_FETCH of this exact URL once B-09 is lifted.

documents.expected_content_note: Confirmed by reading: this document is the primary authority for Phase 1. It settles every fact above except OFF-F03 (application dates), which it explicitly defers to a later press release, and it is amended on age by DOC-OFF-003.

acquisition.acquired_by: the user, in an ordinary browser, from the board's site
acquisition.unblocks: B-09 for this document only; the blocker itself remains open because the environment still cannot reach the board's domain.

checks_passed: Names its issuer in its own text: 'TELANGANA STATE LEVEL POLICE RECRUITMENT BOARD, DGP OFFICE COMPLEX, LAKDI-KA-PUL, HYDERABAD' (page 1).
Carries a file number and date consistent throughout: 'Rc. No. 225 / Rect. / Rect.1 / 2026' and 'Date: 29th July 2026' (page 1).

Every one of the 57 pages carries the same footer identifying the same file number and date, so no page was substituted or appended: 'Rc No. 225 / Rect. / Rect-1 / 2026 dated 29th July 2026' with 'Page N of 57'.
Signed off by a named officer: '(V V SRINIVASA RAO, IPS) CHAIRMAN TSLPRB HYDERABAD' (page 39).

Producer metadata is consistent with a board office document rather than a re-render: Creator and Producer 'Microsoft Word 2024', created 2026-07-30T13:51:10+05:30 — one day after the notification date, not months later.

Mutually corroborated by DOC-OFF-003, which independently cites this document's Rc number AND the specific paragraph 'Para No. 15-B (i)' — a paragraph that is in fact the age-limit paragraph in this document. A fabricated pair would have to agree on internal paragraph numbering.
Both documents cite the same prior order, 'G O Ms No. 87, General Administration (Services-A) Department dated 18-05-2026'.
limitations: NOT digitally signed. pdfsig reports no signature, and the file contains zero occurrences of /Sig, /ByteRange, /Perms and /AcroForm. Absence of a signature is normal for these notifications and is not itself suspicious, but it means authenticity cannot be established cryptographically.

The bytes cannot be compared against the publisher's copy while B-09 stands, so this is not proof of authenticity — it is a recorded basis for treating the document as the board's, open to being overturned by a DIRECT_FETCH byte comparison later.
Not encrypted, no embedded JavaScript, no form fields, all fonts embedded — checked so that 'the file behaves like a plain published PDF' is an observation rather than an assumption.

conflicts.question: Which host is the currently controlling official domain: tgprb.in or tslprb.in?
conflicts.observation: A search-index snippet attributed to tgprb.in read 'Candidates are advised to visit only the official website: www.tslprb.in', while the recruitment PDFs are served from tgprb.in. Telangana's TS-to-TG renaming made both plausible. This is now settled from T1_OFFICIAL text rather than from either snippet.
conflicts.why_it_matters: Every provenance record cites a URL. Citing a superseded domain would make the provenance chain unverifiable later.
conflicts.resolution_rule: Per SPEC-OFF-001 R5, do not choose silently. Resolve from what an official document states about itself, not from search snippets or from which host happened to serve a file.

resolution.answer: The board is the Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB) and its website, as the board itself states, is www.tgprb.in. The two are not competing domains: TSLPRB is the organisation's name and tgprb.in is its web address.
resolution.quote: will be made available on the TSLPRB Website (www.tgprb.in), for direct recruitment
resolution.corroboration: The pairing 'TSLPRB Website' with 'www.tgprb.in' recurs on pages 6, 7, 9 and 20 of the same document (7 occurrences of tgprb.in in total). The string 'tslprb.in' does not occur anywhere in either retrieved document — 0 occurrences across both extraction artefacts.
resolution.consequence_for_this_registry: DOC-OFF-006 (https://www.tslprb.in/) stays registered and unretrieved, because a redirect or a notice on that host would be a useful cross-check, but it is no longer needed to settle this question and blocks nothing.
resolution.residual_uncertainty: Whether tslprb.in also resolves to the board, redirects to tgprb.in, or is unrelated is still unknown and unimportant for provenance: official facts cite tgprb.in because that is the address the board prints in its own notification.
